cassava_simufilam_p3.label: MISS
cassava_simufilam_p3.summary: RETHINK-ALZ (NCT04994483) failed BOTH co-primary endpoints (ADAS-Cog12 and ADCS-ADL); no statistically significant cognitive or functional benefit vs placebo. REFOCUS-ALZ and the OLE were subsequently terminated.

madrigal_resmetirom_p3.label: HIT
madrigal_resmetirom_p3.summary: MAESTRO-NASH (NCT03900429) met BOTH co-primary endpoints at Week 52 (NASH resolution and >=1-stage fibrosis improvement) at both 80mg and 100mg doses; statistically significant vs placebo. Led to accelerated approval (Rezdiffra) 2024-03-14.

cortexyme_atuzaginstat_gain.label: MISS
cortexyme_atuzaginstat_gain.summary: GAIN (NCT03823404) failed both co-primary endpoints (ADAS-Cog11 and ADCS-ADL); no statistically significant cognitive or functional benefit vs placebo in the overall population. Company highlighted a pre-specified P. gingivalis DNA-positive subgroup (n=242) showing ~57% slowing on ADAS-Cog11 (p=0.02), but the trial did not meet its primary objective; program later discontinued (also FDA hold for hepatotoxicity).

karuna_karxt_emergent2.label: HIT
karuna_karxt_emergent2.summary: EMERGENT-2 (NCT04659161) met its primary endpoint: KarXT reduced PANSS total score by -9.6 points vs placebo at Week 5 (p<0.0001), with significant separation on key secondaries. Statistically significant and clinically meaningful; led to FDA approval (Cobenfy) 2024-09-26.
karuna_karxt_emergent2.source: Karuna Therapeutics 2022-08-08 EMERGENT-2 topline press release (8-K)

cytokinetics_aficamten_sequoia.label: HIT
cytokinetics_aficamten_sequoia.summary: SEQUOIA-HCM (NCT05186818) met its primary endpoint: aficamten produced a statistically significant, clinically meaningful improvement in peak oxygen uptake (pVO2) vs placebo at Week 24 (p<0.0001), and met all 10 prespecified secondary endpoints. Supported NDA/MAA filings.

atea_at527_moonsong.label: MISS
atea_at527_moonsong.summary: MOONSONG (Phase 2, NCT04709835) failed its primary endpoint: AT-527 did not achieve a clear/statistically significant reduction in change-from-baseline SARS-CoV-2 viral load (RT-PCR) in the overall mild-to-moderate outpatient population. Atea highlighted a numerical viral-load benefit in a high-risk subgroup, but the trial missed; Roche later returned rights. The Phase 3 MORNINGSKY (NCT04889040) was subsequently Terminated.
atea_at527_moonsong.source: Atea Pharmaceuticals 2021-10-19 Phase 2 MOONSONG topline press release (8-K); shares fell ~70.9% intraday/premarket

phathom_vonoprazan_phalcon_hp.label: HIT
phathom_vonoprazan_phalcon_hp.summary: PHALCON-HP (NCT04167670) met its primary endpoint: both vonoprazan triple and dual regimens achieved non-inferior H. pylori eradication vs lansoprazole triple (mITT 84.7% triple / 78.5% dual vs 78.8%; triple superior, p=0.0001).
phathom_vonoprazan_phalcon_hp.source: Phathom 2021-04-29 PHALCON-HP topline PR (GlobeNewswire); direction up, magnitude not precisely confirmed

tarsus_tp03_saturn1.label: HIT
tarsus_tp03_saturn1.summary: Saturn-1 (NCT04475432) met all primary and secondary endpoints: 44% TP-03 vs 7% vehicle achieved complete collarette cure at Day 43 (p<0.0001) in Demodex blepharitis.
tarsus_tp03_saturn1.source: Tarsus 2021-06-21 Saturn-1 topline PR (GlobeNewswire); direction up, magnitude approximate

beyondspring_plinabulin_dublin3.label: HIT
beyondspring_plinabulin_dublin3.summary: DUBLIN-3 (NCT02504489) met its primary overall-survival endpoint: plinabulin + docetaxel showed a statistically significant OS improvement vs docetaxel in 2nd/3rd-line EGFR-WT NSCLC (drug later not FDA-approved, but the topline was a HIT).

canfite_piclidenoson_comfort.label: HIT
canfite_piclidenoson_comfort.summary: COMFORT (NCT03168256) met its primary endpoint: piclidenoson 3mg PASI-75 9.7% vs placebo 2.6% at Week 16 (p<0.04). Weak/mixed — drug was inferior to Otezla on Week-32 secondaries.
canfite_piclidenoson_comfort.source: Can-Fite 2022-06-29 COMFORT PR; Seeking Alpha reported +23%

actinium_iomab_sierra.label: HIT
actinium_iomab_sierra.summary: SIERRA (NCT02665065) met its primary endpoint: durable complete remission p<0.0001 for Iomab-B conditioning in r/r AML. Key secondary OS (ITT) NOT met (attributed to ~60% control crossover) — basis for the 2024-08-05 FDA rejection and ~-60% repricing 21 months later. Topline call = HIT.
actinium_iomab_sierra.source: Actinium 2022-10-31 SIERRA PR (PR Newswire); 2022 1-day move small/mixed, approximate; economic catalyst was 2024-08-05 FDA news

anika_cingal_1901.label: HIT
anika_cingal_1901.summary: Cingal 19-01 (NCT04231318) met its primary endpoint: superiority over triamcinolone hexacetonide steroid at 26 weeks (WOMAC Pain) in knee OA.
anika_cingal_1901.source: Anika 2022-11-01 Cingal 19-01 PR (GlobeNewswire); positive/muted small-cap reaction, approximate

abeona_eb101_viital.label: HIT
abeona_eb101_viital.summary: VIITAL (NCT04227106) met BOTH co-primary endpoints: 81.4% of EB-101-treated wounds achieved >=50% healing at 6 months vs 16.3% untreated (and significant pain reduction) in RDEB. Led to 2025 FDA approval of pz-cel.
abeona_eb101_viital.source: Abeona 2022-11-03 VIITAL PR (GlobeNewswire); direction strongly up, magnitude approximate

lianbio_mavacamten_explorer_cn.label: HIT
lianbio_mavacamten_explorer_cn.summary: EXPLORER-CN (NCT05174416) met its primary endpoint: mavacamten improved Valsalva LVOT gradient vs placebo at Week 30 (p<0.001), all secondaries positive, in Chinese oHCM patients.
lianbio_mavacamten_explorer_cn.source: LianBio 2023-04-26 EXPLORER-CN PR (GlobeNewswire); positive but muted (cash-rich micro-cap), approximate

kalvista_sebetralstat_konfident.label: HIT
kalvista_sebetralstat_konfident.summary: KONFIDENT (NCT05259917) met all primary and key secondary endpoints: oral sebetralstat gave faster time-to-symptom-relief vs placebo (300mg p<0.0001, 600mg p=0.0013) for on-demand HAE. Later FDA-approved.
kalvista_sebetralstat_konfident.source: KalVista 2024-02-13 KONFIDENT PR; direction up (priced $160M offering 2 days later), magnitude approximate

palatin_pl9643_melody1.label: HIT
palatin_pl9643_melody1.summary: MELODY-1 (NCT05201170) co-primary SPLIT: met the symptom/pain co-primary (p<0.025) but the sign co-primary was positive yet NOT statistically significant. Strict all-co-primaries rule = miss; market treated it as a win (~+15%). Labeled HIT under the price-direction tiebreak.

atea_hcv_combo_p2.label: HIT
atea_hcv_combo_p2.summary: Phase 2 bemnifosbuvir + ruzasvir (NCT05629962) met its primary endpoints (safety + SVR12): 98% (208/213) SVR12 in the per-protocol adherent population for treatment-naive chronic HCV.
atea_hcv_combo_p2.source: Atea 2024-12-04 HCV combo Ph2 PR (GlobeNewswire); direction up, magnitude approximate

candel_can2409_prostate_p3.label: HIT
candel_can2409_prostate_p3.summary: CAN-2409 Phase 3 prostate (NCT01436968) met its primary endpoint: statistically significant DFS improvement (p=0.0155, HR 0.70) plus prostate-cancer-specific survival benefit (HR 0.62, p=0.0046).

summit_ridinilazole_ricodify.label: MISS
summit_ridinilazole_ricodify.summary: Adult Ri-CoDIFy (NCT04781387) DID NOT MEET its primary superiority endpoint (Sustained Clinical Response) vs vancomycin in C. difficile infection; ridinilazole had higher observed SCR but primary superiority missed.

kiniksa_mavrilimumab_ards.label: MISS
kiniksa_mavrilimumab_ards.summary: KPL-301-C203 Phase 3 portion (NCT04447469) DID NOT MEET its primary endpoint (proportion alive and free of mechanical ventilation at Day 29) in COVID-19-related ARDS.

monopar_validive_voice.label: MISS
monopar_validive_voice.summary: VOICE (NCT04648020) interim analysis DID NOT MEET the prespecified efficacy threshold (15% absolute SOM-prevention difference vs placebo); Monopar discontinued the trial and Validive development for futility.
monopar_validive_voice.source: Monopar 2023-03-27 VOICE interim PR; shares fell ~50%+ ($2.98 -> ~$1.45)

annexon_anx007_archer.label: MISS
annexon_anx007_archer.summary: ARCHER Phase 2 (NCT04701164) MISSED its anatomic primary: reduction in GA lesion-growth rate did NOT reach statistical significance; the BCVA vision-loss secondary was significant. Market treated it as a failure.
annexon_anx007_archer.source: Annexon 2023-05-24 ARCHER PR (GlobeNewswire); Zacks ~-50% over the following week

inovio_vgx3100_reveal2.label: MISS
inovio_vgx3100_reveal2.summary: REVEAL 2 (NCT03721978) did NOT achieve statistical significance in the biomarker-selected primary population (lesion regression + viral clearance) for cervical HSIL; Inovio ceased US development of VGX-3100, disclosed inside its Q2-2023 strategic update.
inovio_vgx3100_reveal2.source: Inovio 2023-08-09 Q2 strategic update (PRNewswire); directionally negative/muted (already a sub-$1 micro-cap), approximate

neumora_navacaprant_koastal1.label: MISS
neumora_navacaprant_koastal1.summary: KOASTAL-1 (NCT06029426) DID NOT meet its primary (MADRS Wk6) or key secondary (SHAPS) in MDD — navacaprant and placebo both improved MADRS by 12.5 points (complete overlap).

rigel_fostamatinib_forward.label: MISS
rigel_fostamatinib_forward.summary: FORWARD (NCT03764618) DID NOT demonstrate statistical significance on its primary durable-hemoglobin-response endpoint in the overall wAIHA population (p=0.398); only a post-hoc regional subgroup was favorable.
rigel_fostamatinib_forward.source: Rigel 2022-06-08 FORWARD PR; direction down, magnitude not precisely confirmed

praxis_prax114_aria.label: MISS
praxis_prax114_aria.summary: Aria (NCT04832425) DID NOT achieve statistical significance on its primary (HAM-D17 Day 15) and missed all secondaries; PRAX-114 monotherapy failed in MDD.
praxis_prax114_aria.source: Praxis 2022-06-06 Aria PR (GlobeNewswire); shares cratered ~-75% ($8.59 -> $1.88, GEN)

mirum_maralixibat_march.label: HIT
mirum_maralixibat_march.summary: MARCH (NCT03905330) met its primary endpoint: maralixibat improved pruritus severity in the PFIC2 cohort (p=0.0098), with positive bilirubin and growth secondaries across PFIC subtypes.
mirum_maralixibat_march.source: Mirum 2022-10-24 MARCH PR (BusinessWire); direction up (RJ PT raised to $88), magnitude approximate

cingulate_ctx1301_adult.label: MISS
cingulate_ctx1301_adult.summary: CTx-1301-022 adult ADHD (NCT05631626) did NOT reach statistical significance on its registered PERMP primary (p=0.089); the study was explicitly underpowered (effect-size estimation). Company headlined it 'positive top-line', but the primary was formally not met and the stock fell ~8%.

organogenesis_renu_oa_p3.label: HIT
organogenesis_renu_oa_p3.summary: ReNu Phase 3 knee OA (NCT04636229) met its primary endpoint: statistically significant 6-month knee-pain reduction (p=0.0177) plus maintenance of function (p<0.0001).

soleno_dccr_c602.label: HIT
soleno_dccr_c602.summary: Study C602 randomized-withdrawal period (NCT03714373) met its primary endpoint: placebo-randomized PWS patients worsened on HQ-CT hyperphagia vs those continuing DCCR (p=0.0022). Supported the 2025 VYKAT XR approval.
soleno_dccr_c602.source: Soleno 2023-09-26 C602 PR; $4.43 -> $26.80 close (+505%, Yahoo Finance, ~42M vol)
